title: Bane's Rule of Two remakes the Sith
summary: With Kaan's Brotherhood gone, Bane rebuilds the Sith in hiding under the Rule of Two: one master and one apprentice, who proves worthy by killing the master and then trains a successor. His Order of the Sith Lords will wait a thousand years for revenge.

title: The Ruusan Reformation disarms the Republic
summary: After Ruusan, Chancellor Tarsus Valorum's reforms disband the Republic's standing military, leaving each system to defend itself. The Jedi give up their armies and ranks and answer to the Chancellor, and the Senate's millions of sectors merge into 1,024, each with one Senator.

title: Othone raises the Valley of the Jedi
summary: Defying the Jedi Council, Lord Hoth's former Padawan Johun Othone, backed by Chancellor Valorum, raises a memorial in the Ruusan cavern where the thought bomb fell. The souls it trapped stay bound there, a nexus of Force power, until Kyle Katarn frees them.
sources: Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II

title: Jedi slay a decoy, believing the Sith gone
summary: Seeking Belia Darzu's holocron on Tython, Bane and Zannah kill a Jedi strike team, but Bane is badly hurt. On Ambria, Zannah breaks her cousin Darovit's mind and leaves him for the Jedi, who kill him as the last Sith Lord and stop looking.

title: Zannah defeats Bane and becomes Dark Lord
summary: Suspecting Zannah is waiting for his body to fail, Bane seeks Darth Andeddu's secret of moving into a new body. They duel on Ambria; beaten, Bane tries to seize Zannah's body, but her will drives him out. She makes the Iktotchi Cognus her apprentice.

title: The Chiss outlaw the first strike
note: Worked out by Wookieepedia: Survivor's Quest calls the law a thousand years old, and The Essential Reader's Companion sets that novel in 22 ABY.
summary: The Chiss Ascendancy makes pre-emptive attack a crime punishable by exile: its forces may fight only once struck. The doctrine governs Chiss policy for more than a thousand years, and breaking it will cost the young commander Thrawn his place among his people.

title: The Republic lays waste to Mandalorian Space
summary: Alarmed by the rearmed Mandalorians, who refuse to join the Republic after Ruusan, the Jedi lead Judicial Forces in a pre-emptive strike. Bombardment cripples Mandalore, Concord Dawn and other worlds, leaving deserts for centuries; Mandalorians remember it as the Dral'Han, the Annihilation.
sources: The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett

title: Exiled Jedi Allya founds Dathomir's witch clans
summary: Rather than execute the fallen Jedi Knight Allya, the Republic exiles her to Dathomir's prison colony. She teaches the colony's women to draw on the Force, founding the rancor-riding Witches of Dathomir, and late in life writes the Book of Law to temper their magic.

title: Alkhara's betrayal starts the Tusken blood feud
note: Wookieepedia's timeline sets the massacre in 550 BBY, the year Alkhara reached Tatooine; the Hutt Jabba drove him from the monastery in 516 BBY.
summary: Alkhara, a researcher turned bandit, joins Tatooine's Sand People to wipe out a police garrison, then massacres them. The killings start a feud between Tuskens and settlers that lasts centuries; his gang holes up in a B'omarr monastery that later becomes Jabba's palace.

title: Darth Gean kills the faltering Darth Gravid
note: Worked out by Wookieepedia: Darth Plagueis says Gravid's reign ended some five centuries before a scene it sets just after Padmé Amidala turns thirteen, in 33 BBY.
summary: Drawn toward the Jedi's altruism, Dark Lord Darth Gravid loses his sanity and sets out to destroy the Sith's lore. His apprentice Darth Gean storms his bastion on Jaguada and kills him, but most of the teachings are already gone, a loss felt for generations.

title: The Republic sets aside the Corporate Sector
summary: To end feuds between lawmakers and the galaxy's biggest companies, the Republic hands corporations a few hundred lifeless systems in the Tingel Arm to exploit under its supervision. Under the Empire the Corporate Sector swells to some 30,000 systems, run by the Corporate Sector Authority.
sources: Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook

title: Corellia tries to leave the Republic
summary: Corellia bids for independence under Contemplanys Hermi, an obscure constitutional clause that lets the sector recall its Senators and close its borders. The bid fails and the clause is forgotten until Senator Garm Bel Iblis invokes it against the Military Creation Act in 22 BBY.

title: Keiran Halcyon breaks the Afarathu cult
summary: The Corellian Jedi Knight Keiran Halcyon breaks the Afarathu, a sect of Selonian extremists terrorizing the Corellian system. His bloodline of Corellian Jedi runs down to the Clone Wars hero Nejaa Halcyon and the pilot Corran Horn, who will briefly borrow Keiran's name.

title: The Trade Federation is chartered
summary: The Republic charters the Trade Federation to referee disputes among shipping firms, as giant haulers lock rivals out of Outer Rim spaceports and hoard navigation data. Within a century it becomes a shipping cartel and Senate lobby, later dominated by the Neimoidians.
sources: The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)
Star Wars: Episode I Incredible Cross-Sections

title: Jedi academy ship Chu'unthor crashes on Dathomir
summary: The Chu'unthor, a Jedi academy starship, crashes on Dathomir. Yoda and other Jedi come for its crew but are driven off by the witches and their rancors; after Yoda saves a young witch, Rell, a truce lets them go, leaving the wreck and its library.
conflict: The New Essential Chronology dates the crash to 340 BBY, as Wookieepedia's timeline and its Dathomir article do; the Chu'unthor article itself gives 230 BBY without citing a source.

title: Jedi Council expels the Potentium heretics
summary: Leor Hal's Potentium teaches that the Force has no dark side, only a single whole to explore. It draws Padawans from Coruscant's and Alderaan's great families until the Council expels its followers. Some later settle the living world Zonama Sekot, which takes up their creed.
sources: Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)

title: Corporations win their own seats in the Senate
summary: Two linked Senate laws make the Outer Rim a tax-free trade zone and count guilds and corporations as functional constituencies entitled to Senators. The Trade Federation gains a seat, and the combines that later back the Separatists win a direct voice in lawmaking.

title: The protocol droid C-3PO is activated on Affa
summary: Cybot Galactica starts turning out 3PO protocol droids, and one, later known as C-3PO, is activated on Affa. After decades serving diplomats, among them the emissary of the Manakron system, he ends up gutted and dumped on Tatooine, where the slave boy Anakin Skywalker rebuilds him.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
The New Essential Guide to Droids

title: The Dowager Queen crashes on Tatooine
summary: Taking Tatooine for an empty world, the colony ship Dowager Queen from Bestine IV tries to land and is wrecked by a sandstorm. Its survivors found Bestine, and the town that later grows up around the stripped hulk becomes Mos Eisley.

title: Plagueis kills his master, Darth Tenebrous
summary: Darth Tenebrous, a Bith known publicly as the starship designer Rugess Nome, contains the blast of a sabotaged mining probe on Bal'demnic. His Muun apprentice Plagueis seizes the moment, breaks his neck and studies his midi-chlorians as he dies, becoming Dark Lord of the Sith.

title: Palpatine murders his family and becomes Sidious
summary: The Muun financier Hego Damask, secretly Darth Plagueis, takes an interest in Palpatine, a young Naboo noble at odds with his father. When Cosinga Palpatine tries to send him away, Palpatine kills his whole family in a dark-side rage, and Plagueis names him Darth Sidious.

title: The Hutts take control of Tatooine
summary: The Hutts take over Tatooine, prizing the backwater desert world as a transfer point for smuggled goods between the Corellian Run and the Triellus Trade Route. Hutt clans, Jabba's Desilijic among them, rule its underworld for the next seventy years.

title: Jaster Mereel's code splits the Mandalorians
summary: Jaster Mereel becomes Mandalore and lays down the Supercommando Codex: Mandalorians should fight only as honorable mercenaries. Tor Vizsla's Death Watch breaks away to return to raiding, and civil war follows. In 58 BBY Jaster adopts Jango Fett, a farm boy orphaned by Death Watch.
sources: Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons

title: Qui-Gon's apprentice Xanatos turns to the dark
summary: Sent to Telos IV for his final trial, Qui-Gon's Padawan Xanatos falls under his father Crion's sway. When Qui-Gon is forced to kill Crion, Xanatos quits the Order as a Dark Jedi; nine years later, cornered on Telos, he leaps into acid rather than surrender.
sources: Star Wars: Jedi — The Dark Side
Jedi Apprentice: The Day of Reckoning

title: Jaster Mereel falls; Jango Fett becomes Mandalore
summary: Hired for what looks like easy work on Korda Six, the True Mandalorians walk into a Death Watch ambush. Betrayed by his second-in-command Montross, Jaster Mereel is killed by Tor Vizsla. Jango Fett carries his body back, exposes Montross and succeeds him as Mandalore.
sources: Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons

title: Renegade scientists rise on Arkania
summary: Arkanian scientists who object to the Dominion's genetic tinkering with the Yaka rise in revolt, fielding an army of cyborg Assimilators and committing atrocities of their own. Jedi including Mace Windu intervene, and the Dominion crushes the Renegades.
sources: The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)

title: The Katana fleet vanishes on its maiden voyage
summary: The Katana fleet, two hundred Dreadnaught cruisers slaved together to run on skeleton crews, sets out on its maiden voyage. A hive virus drives the crews mad, and the linked ships jump blindly into hyperspace and vanish. The smuggler Hoffner finds them in 6 BBY.
conflict: Pellaeon's 'fifty-five years' in Dark Force Rising and The New Essential Chronology's completion date point to about 46 BBY, and Wookieepedia's timeline lists the loss in 45 BBY. Karrde's 'about ten years before the Clone Wars' would put it nearer 32 BBY.

title: Iaco Stark's pirates fight the Republic at Troiken
summary: Iaco Stark's combine of pirates, secretly backed by the Trade Federation and bacta maker Xucphra, strangles the Republic's bacta supply. Talks at Troiken collapse into five battles that kill Jedi Master Tyvokka and Senator Ranulph Tarkin. The war, stoked by Sidious, helps make Valorum Chancellor.
sources: Star Wars: The Stark Hyperspace War

title: Jedi wipe out the True Mandalorians at Galidraan
summary: Galidraan's governor, sheltering Death Watch, hires Jango Fett's Mandalorians to crush rebels, then tells the Jedi they are murdering dissidents. Dooku's task force attacks; eleven Jedi and every Mandalorian but Jango die, and Jango is sold into slavery. The deceit shakes Dooku's faith in the Republic.
sources: Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons
Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)

title: Obi-Wan leaves the Order for Melida/Daan's Young
summary: Sent with Qui-Gon to rescue Jedi Tahl from the warring Melida and Daan, thirteen-year-old Obi-Wan sides with the Young, an army of war orphans, and quits the Order. They topple the Elders in fourteen days; after his friend Cerasi is killed, Obi-Wan asks to return.
sources: Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead

title: Plagueis and Sidious tip the Force toward darkness
summary: Plagueis and Sidious enter a joint trance and push the Force toward the dark side, even trying to will a being into existence through the galaxy's midi-chlorians. A decade later Plagueis suspects the Force answered by conceiving Anakin Skywalker, the Chosen One.

title: The Great ReSynchronization resets the calendar
summary: To reconcile the tangle of dating systems across the Republic, the Republic Measures & Standards Bureau adopts a reformed Galactic Standard Calendar with 35 BBY as year zero. Late Republic records count from it: the Stark Hyperspace War falls in 9 BrS, nine years before.
sources: A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded

title: The Yinchorri rise and raid the Jedi Temple
summary: Egged on by Sidious through the rogue Vilmarh Grahrk, the Yinchorri seize the Golden Nyss Shipyards, overrun Mayvitch 7 and dump two murdered Jedi on Valorum's doorstep. Twelve Jedi strike at the Yinchorri worlds as commandos raid the Temple; the Republic wins and disarms them.
sources: Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War

title: Maul wipes out Black Sun's leadership
summary: Sidious sends Maul to throw Black Sun into chaos, in part to repay the syndicate's attempt on Plagueis's life. Maul kills Vigos on Coruscant and Dac, then storms the fortress on Ralltiir where the rest have gathered, slaughtering every Vigo and drowning Underlord Alexi Garyn.

title: Sidious murders Plagueis on election night
summary: On the night the Senate elects Palpatine Supreme Chancellor, Sidious kills his master as the Muun sleeps. Plagueis the Wise, who spent decades hunting the secret of cheating death, dies with his work unfinished, and Sidious becomes the sole Dark Lord of the Sith.

title: Yuuzhan Vong scouts besiege Zonama Sekot
summary: Yuuzhan Vong scouts, invaders from beyond the galaxy whom the settlers call Far Outsiders, try to colonize the living world Zonama Sekot, whose biosphere kills the organisms they bring. Two years of siege end when the Jedi Vergere agrees to leave with them.
sources: The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way

title: Dooku quits the Jedi Order after Naboo
summary: Shaken by Galidraan and embittered by Qui-Gon Jinn's death on Naboo, Dooku resigns from the Order without explanation, the twentieth Master to walk away; the Archives add his bust to those of the Lost Twenty. He reclaims his title as Count of Serenno.
sources: Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)
Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)
The New Essential Guide to Characters

title: Zonama Sekot escapes Tarkin into the Unknown Regions
summary: Seeking Vergere's fate, Obi-Wan and Anakin find Zonama Sekot growing living starships. Tarkin and Raith Sienar strike with Trade Federation forces to seize it, but the planet jumps into hyperspace. Tarkin saves face by giving Palpatine Sienar's plans for a giant battle station.

title: Shimrra seizes the Yuuzhan Vong throne
summary: News of Zonama Sekot shakes Supreme Overlord Quoreal, who wants the Yuuzhan Vong to seek another galaxy. Backed by the most aggressive domains, the Intendant Shimrra Jamaane has him killed and takes his place, committing the Vong to the invasion that comes decades later.
sources: The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force
The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy

title: Outbound Flight is destroyed in the Unknown Regions
summary: Jedi Master Jorus C'baoth leads Outbound Flight, six Dreadnaughts of colonists and Jedi bound for the Unknown Regions. At Sidious's request the Chiss commander Thrawn cripples it; Sidious's agent Kinman Doriana deals the final blow, and the wreck falls onto a planetoid where survivors hold on.

title: Yaddle dies absorbing a chemical weapon
note: Wookieepedia's timeline lists her death under 25 BBY; her own article gives 26 BBY.
summary: On a peacekeeping mission to lawless Mawan with Obi-Wan and Anakin, Yaddle uses the Force to pull a deadly chemical weapon released by Granta Omega, Xanatos's son, into her own body, dying to save the city's people. Shaak Ti takes her seat on the Council.

title: Jedi keep Ansion in the Republic
summary: The Commerce Guild schemes to pull Ansion out of the Republic, and with it dozens of treaty-bound worlds. Luminara Unduli and Obi-Wan, with their Padawans Barriss Offee and Anakin, cross its plains to end the feud between city-dwellers and nomadic Alwari, and Ansion stays.

title: The Jedi stop Dooku's Dark Reaper
summary: A Separatist attack on remote Rhen Var opens Dooku's plan to rebuild the Dark Reaper, an ancient Sith weapon that feeds on the life energy of its victims. Mace Windu, Obi-Wan and Anakin fight across Rhen Var, Raxus Prime and Thule to destroy it.
sources: Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)

title: The Republic storms the Banking Clan's Muunilinst
summary: Obi-Wan and Anakin strike Muunilinst, home of the Banking Clan and its droid foundries. ARC troopers crack Harnaidan's defenses, Obi-Wan defeats the bounty hunter Durge, and Dooku's assassin Asajj Ventress lures Anakin to a duel on Yavin 4. The Republic takes the planet.

title: Mace Windu seeks his fallen Padawan
summary: Mace Windu returns to his jungle homeworld for his former Padawan Depa Billaba, sent to aid a Korun uprising against the Separatists that has turned savage. He finds the jungle's darkness has claimed her; she attacks him, and their struggle leaves her in a coma.

title: General Grievous makes his debut at Hypori
summary: Acting on Daakman Barrek's intelligence, a Republic force raids Hypori's droid foundries and walks into a trap. The Separatists' new Supreme Commander, the cyborg General Grievous, kills Barrek and other Jedi; only Ki-Adi-Mundi, Shaak Ti, Aayla Secura and K'Kruhk survive, pulled out by ARC troopers.

title: The Republic is ground down on Jabiim
summary: The Republic backs Jabiim's loyalists against Separatist-armed nationalists in a campaign fought through endless rain and mud. Obi-Wan is presumed dead, Anakin obeys Palpatine's order to evacuate while a band of Padawans dies holding the line, and the abandoned loyalists curse the Republic.
sources: Star Wars: Republic: The Battle of Jabiim

title: Ventress fakes her death at Boz Pity
note: Wookieepedia dates the battle 19.43 BBY, two years and seven months after the Battle of Geonosis.
summary: Hunting Asajj Ventress, Obi-Wan uncovers a Separatist stronghold at Boz Pity, and a Jedi-led fleet under Mace Windu defeats Dooku and Grievous there. Gravely wounded, Ventress feigns death with Sith meditation, then has her medical transport carry her away from the war and Dooku.

title: Palpatine puts Moffs over the sectors
summary: Palpatine decrees that governors of his choosing will oversee every planet and sector, creating the office of Moff, nominally for the war effort. The move sidelines the Senate, spurs the Petition of 2000 and gives the coming Empire its regional chain of command.
sources: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)

title: The Empire crushes the Nosaurians of New Plympto
summary: Betrayed by his clones at Order 66, Jedi General Dass Jennir returns to New Plympto and leads its Nosaurian rebels, his former enemies, against the Empire. After a month of guerrilla war, the 501st breaks their last stand at Half-Axe Pass, killing nearly all of them.

title: The Caamas Firestorm
summary: Seeing the free-thinking, Republic-loyal Caamasi as a threat, Palpatine has Bothan agents switch off Caamas's planetary shields, and Star Destroyers set the world ablaze. Only some two hundred Caamasi there survive; the Empire blames stray Separatist bombs, and the Bothans' role stays hidden for decades.
sources: Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows

title: Palpatine makes Byss his secret throne world
summary: Soon after the Clone Wars, Palpatine claims Byss, a hidden Deep Core paradise, as his secret throne world. Slaves raise his citadel, and he feeds on the Force energy of settlers lured there, turning Byss into a dark side nexus where his spare clone bodies wait.

title: Two Jedi sabotage the Eye of Palpatine
summary: Palpatine builds the Eye of Palpatine, a battlemoon disguised as an asteroid, to wipe out Jedi children sheltered by Master Plett on Belsavis. Jedi Knights Geith Eris and Callista Ming sabotage it; Callista traps her spirit in its computer to stop it, and the children escape.

title: The 501st takes Naboo and kills its queen
summary: Queen Apailana breaks with the Empire and shelters fugitive Jedi on Naboo. Vader sends the 501st Legion, which crushes the Royal Security Forces, kills the Jedi and assassinates the young queen; the Empire puts the compliant Kylantha on the throne.

title: A'Sharad Hett takes the road to Darth Krayt
summary: The Order 66 survivor A'Sharad Hett leads Tusken raids on Tatooine until Obi-Wan defeats him near the Lars homestead and makes him swear to leave. Hett turns bounty hunter, then on Korriban learns the Sith ways from the spirit of XoXaan; he will become Darth Krayt.
sources: The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi

title: The 501st crushes a clone uprising on Kamino
summary: Resenting Imperial control, Kaminoan Clone Masters grow an army of Jango Fett clones to turn against the Empire. Guided by Boba Fett, who knows Tipoca City from boyhood, the 501st wipes out the rebel clones and their makers. The Empire turns to other templates and recruits.

title: The Second Great Droid Revolution
summary: The cyborg Archa Sabis uploads a virus that turns Coruscant's police cruisers and construction droids against their owners. The Empire quickly crushes the short-lived revolt and turns the public's fear of droids to its own advantage.
sources: The New Essential Guide to Droids

title: Palpatine learns to outlive his own body
summary: From the Tedryn Holocron, taken from the captured Jedi archivist Ashka Boda, Palpatine learns how to move his spirit into a cloned body. He stocks secret storehouses such as Mount Tantiss on Wayland with treasures and cloning gear, killing the architect of its maze.
sources: Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)
conflict: Wookieepedia's timeline sets the discovery and Mount Tantiss's completion in 8 BBY, but the Dark Empire endnotes say Palpatine held the holocron for thirty years, which puts its capture near the start of the Jedi Purge in 19 BBY.

title: Vader's bombardment kills Xizor's family on Falleen
summary: A flesh-eating bacterium escapes Vader's bioweapons lab on Falleen. Vader has the lab and everything within forty kilometers bombarded from orbit, killing 200,000 Falleen, among them the royal family of Prince Xizor, who has just taken control of Black Sun. Xizor quietly vows revenge.
sources: Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)
Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption

title: Han Solo saves Chewbacca and loses his commission
summary: Top of his class at the Imperial Academy, Lieutenant Han Solo refuses an order to skin a wounded Wookiee slave, Chewbacca, then stops an officer from whipping him. Han is court-martialed and cashiered; Chewbacca swears him a life debt, and the two turn smuggler.
sources: Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook

title: Lando Calrissian defeats the sorcerer Rokur Gepta
summary: Rokur Gepta, a Croke illusionist who killed his fellow Sorcerers of Tund and poisoned their world, blames Lando Calrissian for losing him the Mindharp of Sharu and hunts him. In the ThonBoka nebula, Lando saves the space-dwelling Oswaft from Gepta and the Empire, and kills him.
sources: Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka
Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu
Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon

title: Vader's secret apprentice hunts the last Jedi
note: Wookieepedia's timeline lists the hunt under 2 BBY; the articles on Kazdan Paratus and Shaak Ti date their deaths to 3 BBY.
summary: Taken after Vader killed his Jedi father on Kashyyyk, Galen Marek grows up as Vader's secret apprentice, Starkiller. He kills Jedi survivors, Kazdan Paratus on Raxus Prime and Shaak Ti on Felucia, then gathers the Empire's enemies for a supposed plot against the Emperor.

title: Palpatine names twelve Grand Admirals
summary: At the New Year Fete Week celebrations, Palpatine unexpectedly names twelve Grand Admirals, a new rank above even the Grand Moffs that answers only to him. Months before Endor one of them, Demetrius Zaarin, attempts a coup and is replaced by the Chiss Thrawn.

title: Han Solo wins the Millennium Falcon from Lando
summary: In the final round of a sabacc tournament on Cloud City, Lando Calrissian stakes any ship on his Nar Shaddaa sales lot, forgetting that his own Millennium Falcon is parked there. Han Solo wins and claims the Falcon on the technicality.

title: Han Solo breaks open the Stars' End prison
summary: Helping a band searching for relatives who vanished into the Corporate Sector Authority's secret prison, Han loses Chewbacca to its police. He traces the prison, Stars' End, to Mytus VII, frees the prisoners from stasis, and leaves the crippled tower blasted into a suborbital arc.
sources: Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook

title: The Corellian Treaty founds the Rebel Alliance
summary: When Vader seizes the dissidents Galen Marek gathered on Corellia, Marek follows them to the Death Star and dies holding off the Emperor while they escape. Mon Mothma, Bail Organa and Garm Bel Iblis sign the Corellian Treaty, founding the Rebel Alliance under Marek's family crest.

title: Grand Moff Trachta plots against the Sith
summary: Grand Moff Trachta and fellow officers plot to kill Palpatine and Vader with a hundred clone stormtroopers bred to obey Trachta alone, and take the Empire for themselves. The plotters turn on each other, the Sith cut down the rest, and only the assassin Gauer survives.
sources: The Official Star Wars Fact File 122

title: A Starkiller clone leads the rebels to Kamino
summary: Hoping to recreate his lost apprentice, Vader grows clones of Galen Marek on Kamino. One escapes, frees Rahm Kota and leads a rebel fleet back to Kamino, where the Alliance wrecks Timira City's cloning labs and takes Vader prisoner, its first major victory. He soon escapes.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II
Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)

title: Tarkin hides a weapons lab inside the Maw
note: Wookieepedia dates the Installation's construction only to between 19 and 0 BBY; its timeline sets Daala's posting in 0 BBY, just before the Battle of Yavin.
summary: Tarkin builds a hidden weapons laboratory inside the Maw, a cluster of black holes, staffed by prodigies such as Qwi Xux, taken as children from Omwat. It designs the Death Star's prototype, and Admiral Daala's Star Destroyers guard it, cut off, long after the Empire falls.

title: The Death Star's first shot destroys Despayre
note: Days before the Battle of Yavin; placed just before year zero on the archive's axis.
summary: With the Death Star's construction site above the prison world Despayre found by the Alliance, Tarkin moves the nearly finished station, first testing its superlaser on the only planet in range. Despayre and every prisoner on it are destroyed, days before the Battle of Yavin.

title: Rebels seize the Death Star plans at Toprawa
note: Days before the Battle of Yavin; placed just before year zero on the archive's axis.
summary: Rebels raid a convoy above Toprawa for Death Star plans, add pieces taken on the surface and by Kyle Katarn on Danuta, and seize a relay to beam them to Leia's Tantive IV. Bria Tharen's Red Hand Squadron dies holding it, and the Empire razes Toprawa.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope
Star Wars: The National Public Radio Dramatization

title: Vader blockades the rebels at Yavin
note: Wookieepedia dates the blockade from 0 to 0.5 ABY, ending six months after the Battle of Yavin.
summary: After Yavin, Vader blockades the Yavin system and pins the Alliance down for six months. When the rebels break out, Admiral Griff leaps into hyperspace after them and emerges on top of Vader's waiting flagship, the Executor; three Star Destroyers are lost and the rebels escape.

title: Kyle Katarn destroys the Dark Trooper Project
summary: General Rom Mohc wins backing for his dark troopers, armored battle droids that wipe out the rebel base on Talay in minutes. Rebel agent Kyle Katarn, a former Imperial officer, tracks the program and destroys its factory ship, the Arc Hammer, killing Mohc.

title: Crix Madine defects after the Dentaal plague
note: Dated by Wookieepedia's timeline; the Crix Madine article gives no year for the defection.
summary: Crix Madine, who founded the Empire's storm commandos, obeys an order to unleash the Candorian plague on Dentaal, then defects to the Rebel Alliance in disgust, losing his fiancée in the escape. He becomes one of the Alliance's leading commanders of special operations.
sources: Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide

title: The Bounty Hunter Wars break the Guild
note: Wookieepedia's timeline lists the Guild's split under 0 ABY; the Bounty Hunter Wars article dates the war's start to 1 ABY.
summary: At Prince Xizor's urging, Palpatine sends Boba Fett to wreck the Bounty Hunters' Guild from inside. Fett joins under its aging leader Cradossk; the Guild splits into the True Guild and the Guild Reform Committee, whose hunters turn on each other until the Guild is finished.

title: Luke and Leia find the Kaiburr crystal
summary: Stranded on swampy Mimban, Luke and Leia join the self-styled seer Halla in hunting the Kaiburr crystal, which magnifies the Force. In its temple Vader cuts Leia down, but Luke severs Vader's arm and the Dark Lord falls into a well; the crystal heals them.
sources: The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader

title: Shira Brie is reborn as the Sith Lumiya
note: The shootdown follows the Battle of Hoth; Vader presents Lumiya to Palpatine a few months before Endor, in 4 ABY.
summary: Planted in the Alliance as a pilot, the Imperial spy Shira Brie is shot down by Luke acting on a Force warning. Vader rebuilds her with cybernetics and trains her as Lumiya, Dark Lady of the Sith; in 4 ABY Palpatine makes her an Emperor's Hand.
sources: The New Essential Guide to Characters

title: Bothans die for the new Death Star's plans
summary: Rebels seize a computer core holding the second Death Star's plans from the freighter Suprosa and hide it with Bothan spies on Kothlis. Bounty hunters raid the safehouse and take Luke, many Bothans die, and Crix Madine's commandos pull the data from a crashed Star Destroyer.
sources: Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)
Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader

title: Vader kills Xizor and Black Sun falls apart
summary: Black Sun's Prince Xizor plots to kill Luke and take Vader's place, and holds Leia captive. Rebels break her out and blow up his Coruscant palace; Xizor flees to his skyhook, which Vader's Executor blasts apart with him aboard. Black Sun falls into chaos.
sources: Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)
Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)
The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire

title: The Emperor's Hand Mara Jade stalks Luke
summary: Raised from childhood as Palpatine's secret assassin, the Emperor's Hand Mara Jade waits in Jabba's palace disguised as the dancer Arica to kill Luke, but never gets the chance. As Palpatine dies at Endor, she hears his last command: kill Luke Skywalker.
sources: Sleight of Hand: The Tale of Mara Jade
Star Wars: Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand

title: IG-88's droid revolution dies with the Death Star
summary: The IG-88 assassin droids, having killed their makers and seized the factory world Mechis III, plot to turn the galaxy's droids against organic life. Their leader IG-88A uploads his mind into the second Death Star's computer and dies with it at Endor before the revolt begins.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi
Therefore I Am: The Tale of IG-88
The New Essential Guide to Droids

title: Rebels and Imperials unite against the Ssi-ruuk
summary: Imperial Bakura begs for help against the Ssi-ruuk, who power their droid fighters with captives' life energy. An Alliance force under Luke, Han and Leia fights beside the Imperials; when Governor Nereus betrays the truce, his commander Pter Thanas defects and Bakura joins the Alliance.
